purpose: Inspect JSON-compatible data in an expandable keyboard tree with bounded branch disclosure and copy helpers.
behaviorProvider: Native tree semantics and local branch model; shared Button for global actions.

component: Represent plain/null-prototype objects, arrays, strings, booleans, finite numbers and null; identify other kinds as unsupported and repeated ancestor references as circular.

Visit only expanded branches and disclose each container in maxVisibleItems pages clamped to at least one, with a finite fallback of one hundred. Stop building descendants at depth fifty; clamp initial expansion to at most eight levels.
Use dollar-root paths with array indexes, dot notation for identifier keys and JSON-quoted bracket notation otherwise. Paths identify tree focus, expansion and copy actions.
host: Supply ordinary inert JSON data rather than hostile proxies/getters or executable objects. Object key/property access is not sandboxed; bounded display does not bound total object enumeration or whole-branch copying.
Review focus recovery and path-state reuse when replacing datasets with unrelated content. Remount for a fresh default expansion model if that is the desired product behavior.

requirements.statement: Represent plain/null-prototype objects, arrays, strings, booleans, finite numbers and null; identify other kinds as unsupported and repeated ancestor references as circular.

Visit only expanded branches and disclose each container in maxVisibleItems pages clamped to at least one, with a finite fallback of one hundred. Stop building descendants at depth fifty; clamp initial expansion to at most eight levels.
Use dollar-root paths with array indexes, dot notation for identifier keys and JSON-quoted bracket notation otherwise. Paths identify tree focus, expansion and copy actions.
Maintain a roving active treeitem, expose level/position/set size and branch aria-expanded, and support Up/Down/Home/End, Right expand-or-child, Left collapse-or-parent, and Enter/Space toggle.
On a focused tree row, Control/Command+C copies its JSON value and Shift adds path copying only when no text selection exists. Nested action controls keep their own event handling.

Reject circular or unsupported JSON serialization with a status message. On clipboard success show temporary copied state and call onCopy; on clipboard failure provide a labelled read-only textarea that selects on focus.

Rebuild visible node data when value changes while retaining path-based expansion/limits. If focusedId disappears use the root as the active tab stop; this does not programmatically recover DOM focus from a removed node.

Supply ordinary inert JSON data rather than hostile proxies/getters or executable objects. Object key/property access is not sandboxed; bounded display does not bound total object enumeration or whole-branch copying.
Review focus recovery and path-state reuse when replacing datasets with unrelated content. Remount for a fresh default expansion model if that is the desired product behavior.
Consume code group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: No search, editing, schema validation or arbitrary-depth rendering; depth cap is a display boundary.
Only the copied-state timer is cleaned up; clipboard operations themselves are not abortable.
A finite visible page size does not make unlimited input objects safe to process.
